doc: The gateway-URL contract, as data. Vendored byte-identical into every repo that carries a copy of the normaliser; each repo's tests/test_gateway_url_conformance.py binds its OWN entry point to this table and pins this file's sha256. The normaliser itself cannot be shared - 14 repos, 14 module paths, different env-var tuples, different exception hierarchies, different public APIs - so the BEHAVIOUR is the shared artefact, not the bytes of the code. See docs/LLM_GATEWAY.md, 'Fourteen copies, one contract'.

vectors.why: the exact vendor API host. The only shape the original set-membership check caught.
same host, gateway-shaped path. Path is irrelevant; the host is the bill.
the bare registrable domain. Accepted by 12 of 14 implementations before this table.
a subdomain of a vendor host. Accepted by 12 of 14 implementations before this table.
trailing dot is the DNS root: resolves to the identical addresses. Accepted by ALL 14 implementations before this table, including the two that already matched subdomains.
case is not a bypass.
case and root dot together are not a bypass.
a port is not a bypass.
userinfo decoy: the host is everything after '@'. Reads like the gateway, is not.
a second vendor, to prove the list is not Anthropic-only.
Google's model endpoint.
under googleapis.com. Not a model endpoint, but nobody's gateway lives there either, and a denylist that has to be right about which subdomain bills you is a denylist that will one day be wrong.
under huggingface.co.
a two-label vendor domain is still a vendor domain.
and its API subdomain.

embeds a vendor domain without sitting under it. Reaches evil.tld - carrying the prompt and this service's gateway token - while reading like the vendor to a human scanning a variable list. REVERSES an earlier deliberate decision to accept this.
the same shape on a host we own. Still refused: the check cannot tell the two apart, and the fix is one rename.
Cyrillic small a. Non-ASCII hostnames are refused outright rather than compared against a homograph table we would have to maintain.

a different registrable domain that merely ends in the vendor's string. The naive host.endswith('anthropic.com') fix refuses this, and a guard that refuses correct configurations is one people learn to route around.
same trap, one label long.
same trap against a two-label vendor domain.
punycode is ASCII and is read normally. The non-ASCII refusal is not a ban on IDN.
the canonical form: origin + mount, no /v1, no /v1/messages.
a trailing slash is not a second convention.
trimmed.
echo's shipped value. Trimmed to the same string NovahPrime shipped.
whitespace from a copy-paste into a Railway variable.
a subdomain of a host we own is not a vendor.
plain http to a remote host: the gateway token and the prompt both cross that hop.
both wrong at once; either alone is enough.
a local gateway in dev.
same, by address.
not an http(s) URL.
no scheme, so no host: urlsplit reads it as a path.
a path with no origin.
not a URL at all.
unset. Absence of a decision is never permission.
